scientific_question: Can the expert-specific angle-gradient conflict left by the rejected shared butterfly be represented by at most seven global conditional tangent directions, the largest rank that keeps the complete c_fc family above 200x compression?

causal_parent.finding: All expert pairs have negative shared-angle gradient cosine with mean -0.14218 and cancellation ratio 0.000265, but fully unshared one-sweep frames recover only 0.456 function. Sharing is harmful but one sweep is insufficient.

source.terminal_gauge: Recompute each expert's normalized functional-objective gradient at its exact saved shared endpoint, using the exact parent routed discovery samples and terminal dense c_proj.

coordinate_budget.conclusion: Seven is the exact largest global conditional tangent rank compatible with the 200x c_fc target; per-layer full templates and rank eight are forbidden by accounting.

audit.global_cross_bank: Fit a right-singular-vector basis of ranks 1 through 7 to row-normalized, within-layer-centered expert gradients from one discovery bank across all three registered layers; project corresponding gradients from the untouched bank and reverse train/test banks.
audit.per_layer_localization: Repeat rank-1 through rank-7 cross-bank projection independently per layer as a nondeployable localization oracle. A strong per-layer but weak global result identifies cross-layer template sharing as the remaining budget bottleneck.
audit.stability: Measure direct cosine between corresponding centered expert gradients across banks, plus coefficient cosine after projection into each training-bank basis.
audit.no_function_claim: This audit measures first-order tangent coverage only. Even a pass cannot overturn the one-sweep functional rejection or authorize training.

decision_rule.global_rank7_supported: All global rank-7 and corresponding-gradient stability gates pass in both A-to-B and B-to-A directions. Authorize only an all-layer zero-update acquisition followed by a separately preregistered functional oracle of a rank-7 global conditional tangent; do not implement training.
decision_rule.cross_layer_sharing_limit: A global gate fails but every per-layer localization gate passes in both directions. Record that stable expert conflict exists but a global seven-template basis cannot share it across layers; do not implement because per-layer templates violate 200x.
decision_rule.cross_bank_instability: Per-layer localization or direct corresponding-gradient stability fails. Close the fixed-endpoint conditional tangent route because the expert directions are not stable across activation banks.
decision_rule.budget_route_rejected: Any remaining failure rejects the rank-at-most-seven global conditional tangent route. No rank-eight, per-layer-template, seed, threshold, or optimizer sweep is authorized.
